company.shortDescription: Unifonic is a customer engagement platform that unifies communication channels to enable organizations to delight customers.
company.description: Unifonic is a software-as-a-service (SaaS) company. It develops a communications platform used by organizations to send and manage messages and interactions across multiple channels such as SMS, voice calls, WhatsApp, and web chat through a single system.
